market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with upside bias from Wall Street strength and bank outperformance, but capped by RBA hike signal, AUD weakness, and fuel-price inflation. Qantas strike and Bathla contagion create idiosyncratic volatility. Expect ^AXJO to test recent highs on financials but face headwinds from rate-sensitive sectors.
market_outlook.long_term: Higher-for-longer rates and IMF fiscal pressure cap equity multiples. Structural tailwinds from AI infrastructure (Anthropic QLD), WA mining pipeline, and commodity export strength support selective outperformance. Housing correction risk and real wage stagnation are medium-term overhangs for consumer and REIT sectors.
